wiki.title: Juan Alanis (politician)
wiki.extract: Juan Alanis (born June 17, 1978) is an American Republican politician who is currently serving in the California State Assembly for the 22nd district since 2022. Previously, he was a sergeant with the Stanislaus County Sheriff's Department from 1995 to 2022.
